author: Tarheelkiwi
body: So I have noticed that some players on their profile have the "Offline" under their name instead of "Last seen ... hours ago"  and I was wondering why this is.  I tried to find some pattern with players banned, not on the server, or on the website and it is almost random.  Just wondering what this is because it is confusing me.
